segments.comment: Independent monmove.c dochug() case for its wield check `!(mtmp->mtrapped && !nearby && select_rwep(mtmp))`, which calls weapon.c select_rwep() only for a trapped monster that is not adjacent to the hero. The debug-mode Valkyrie steps two squares south off the upstair, wishes for a bear trap (letter e) and arms it under herself, then creates a soldier beside her; at this seed it appears west of her carrying a spear. Two steps east take her two squares from the trap square along the soldier's straight-line approach, so the soldier walks onto the trap and is caught at distance 2. Its following moves run dochug()'s wield check with mtrapped set and nearby false, reaching select_rwep(), and the rests at the end give it those moves.
